claim: Microsoft's fiscal Q4 2026 revenue rose 18% year over year.
summary: Microsoft fiscal Q4 2026 ends after the knowledge cutoff, so the claimed 18% YoY revenue growth cannot be verified from existing knowledge.

sub_claims.text: Microsoft's fiscal Q4 2026 revenue rose 18% year over year.
sub_claims.stated_text: Microsoft's fiscal Q4 2026 revenue rose 18% year over year.
sub_claims.note: Knowledge cutoff is 2026-01-04, which predates the end of Microsoft fiscal Q4 2026 (quarter ending June 30, 2026) and its earnings report. The claimed 18% YoY revenue growth cannot be established from pre-cutoff knowledge alone.
